name: logo and tagline fade over the dimmed diorama
looks: The same shopfront scene dims further and blurs slightly as a small chat-bubble mark and bold wordmark fade up centred over it, with a two-line tagline settling beneath, the mascot a faint silhouette in the background.
build: wordmark-assemble's settle stage over the held establishing shot (reused from the open), the background given a gaussian blur and darker grade to push it back; the tagline's second line (a continuation of the first) reveals on a clipPath wipe.
sound: A soft pad swell, quiet under the settle.
prompt: Dim and softly blur the opening establishing scene, and fade up a small mark and bold wordmark centred over it, with a two-line tagline settling beneath that completes the thought the film opened on. Let the mascot or hero element sit as a faint silhouette behind the text.
